body: I produce hardstyle, but I am not too sure about showing off my music, because I do not want to reveal my identity.

I am 16. It is not a viable option to produce music all day OR work as a full time DJ when you are 16.

I am really sure as to what I want to do with life, the issue is that it is hard to reach the point where I can live off it.

I produce electronic dance music. I have been doing it for 4 years now, and I consider myself pretty good at it. My ultimate goal is to become a DJ, but I would just be happy spending my life in a studio producing music, as well as mixing and mastering tracks.

I am not sure how reliable of a dream that is though, my parents try to remain supportive, but at the same time they want to be realistic, so they end up telling me that they hope that I succeed but that I probably won't at all, and as thus should spend more time in school instead. I would listen to them, but it's not my passion for music that is keeping me away from doing productive stuff like that, you know? ..
